content: Letter 43, to Ghiyās al-Dīn Ḥāfiẓ, i.e., the Ghiyās al-Dīn Ḥāfiẓ Rāzī of letter 12: a brief letter of well-wishing to Iskandar's former chief vizier, now primarily occupied with teaching (the author speaks of his mass of students). MK reads the changed epithet in the address (mamālik al-ḥaqāʾiq in letter 12, jawāhir al-ḥaqāʾiq here) as reflecting the intervening end of Ḥāfiẓ's political career with Iskandar's downfall (TMN/MS p. 31, TMN/D p. 212).
